skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Saturated Within Rain
skins.content: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Saturated Within Rain. Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, matching a scene of beauty and wonder recorded in an ancient tome. Remember to bring a paper umbrella, for within, the drops of ink now fall as gentle rains.
skins.quote: The gentle showers soak the city's green leaves bold. The rainbow half up the mount shines on village old.

skins.name: Wildness Behind
skins.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Wildness Behind. The clothes Honeyberry envisioned during her studies as she described her own prospects to her sickly mother, their intricacies drawn from her mother's wardrobe.
skins.quote: Within fledgling dreams leer cruelty unfit for such an age, but Honeyberry's mother is so glad to see the courage still there, still alive in her girl.
